There is evidence of a dose-response relationship, whereby higher exercise volumes correlate with a greater degree of myodamage (199). Symptoms of EIMD include decreased force-producing capacity, increased musculoskeletal stiffness and swelling, delayed-onset muscle soreness (DOMS), and a heightened physiological stress response typified by an elevated heart rate response to submaximal exercise and heightened lactate production (270).
